hypothesisOrigin: Selected after seeing the retrospective results. Of 3 horizons and 15 groups, the 20-day horizon and the top-5 comparison are tested here because the retrospective study showed a positive mean difference there, alongside a negative median, concentration in one pair and non-monotonic quintiles. This is a future confirmation attempt of a selected hypothesis, not an independently preselected finding; the retrospective figures are not evidence for it.
question: In crypto-usdt-v1 scans recorded before their outcome window began, was the mean 20-day price change of the top 5 ranked pairs above the same-date equal-weight mean of evaluated pairs?
interpretation: A comparison of price changes between groups of pairs. Not a net trading return, not a portfolio return, not proof of profitability and not a trading system.

unchanged.rule: Weights, thresholds, window, freshness, eligibility, ranking and membership stay as committed. A scan under any other scanner, model, candle policy, provider, universe source or membership is excluded and counted, never pooled; changing any of them is a new study.

timing.decisionCutoff: The scan's own frozen cutoff R: its retrieval start, recorded as the snapshot's startedAt and the scan's evaluationTime (tradingview-crypto-daily-v1)
timing.scoredDay: D = the UTC day before the day R falls on: the last UTC day closed by R. Every pair rests on its D candle or is not evaluated
timing.referencePrice: OPEN of the daily bar opening at the UTC midnight after R, D+2 00:00:00.000 UTC: the first bar opening strictly after R. One day later than the retrospective study's D+1 open, because a live scan for D can exist only during D+1 and no part of the outcome window may precede the recorded scan
timing.endpointPrice: OPEN of the daily bar opening 20 UTC days after the reference bar, D+22 00:00 UTC
timing.change: endpoint / reference - 1, in percent; price only, quoted in USDT
timing.recordBy: The snapshot's completedAt must be before the reference bar opens (the UTC midnight after R)

period.retrievalDays: 2026-11-13 through 2027-11-12, UTC: R falls on D+1
period.excluded: Every scored day up to 2026-11-11. Their outcomes were inspected in the retrospective study (through 2026-11-08), or they were scored or partly retrieved before this freeze (2026-11-09 to 2026-11-11). 2026-11-12 had not begun when this was frozen
period.analysisNotBeforeReason: Outcomes use only bars closed at the outcome retrieval’s cutoff, so the last endpoint bar (2027-12-03) must have closed
period.interimLooks: None of the outcome. Before the analysis, only collection status is checked: which days have a PROSPECTIVE snapshot. No change, rank-group return or difference of this study is computed or inspected earlier

categories.prospective: PROSPECTIVE: a crypto-usdt-v1 snapshot from an owner-initiated TradingView retrieval, scored day in the period, saved before its reference bar opened, under the unchanged versions and membership, whose recorded outputs reproduce from its recorded inputs offline (MATCH). Its recorded ranks are the observation; nothing is re-scored
categories.reconstructed: RECONSTRUCTED: a scored day in the period without a PROSPECTIVE snapshot, replayed later from the outcome retrieval with the retrospective study's frozen replay (candles closed by D's close) and measured on the same reference and endpoint bars. Labeled, reported in a separate table, never pooled with PROSPECTIVE, never counted toward the collection minimum or the classification
categories.notProspective: A snapshot saved at or after its reference bar opened, under another version or membership, or that does not reproduce: counted with its reason; its day can only be RECONSTRUCTED
categories.duplicates: Several PROSPECTIVE snapshots for one scored day: the earliest saved is the observation; the rest are counted
categories.noBackfill: A day becomes PROSPECTIVE only through a snapshot saved in time. Nothing recorded later, however exact, is ever moved into that category

collection.requirement: This specification collects nothing. Each PROSPECTIVE observation needs the owner, in an agent session with TradingView’s MCP server, to run tradingview-start --universe crypto-usdt-v1, capture every pair and tradingview-finish on day D+1, finishing before the next UTC midnight, and to keep the snapshot in .zerochart-scans. No scheduler, campaign or automation is added. Record every day, whatever the market does: choosing days by market conditions biases the sample
collection.evidence: The snapshot's scanId, startedAt, completedAt, repositoryCommit and file sha256. These are the owner's machine's own timestamps: they order events on that machine, they are not an independent attestation
collection.outcomeRetrieval: One owner-initiated crypto-usdt-v1 retrieval started on or after 2027-12-04, by the same workflow. Its 1000 daily bars cover the whole period; nothing is fetched from another source
collection.minimum: At least 240 PROSPECTIVE scored days with at least 15 pairs EVALUATED and a measurable day difference, and at least 8 of them in each of the 21 phase series. Otherwise the result is INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION

primaryComparison.group: top5: ranks 1-5 of the recorded scan among its EVALUATED pairs (score descending, then ticker)
primaryComparison.baseline: The same-date equal-weight mean change of every EVALUATED pair in the recorded scan with an AVAILABLE outcome, the top 5 included
primaryComparison.dayDifference: Δ_d = mean change of the top 5 with AVAILABLE outcomes minus the baseline: one value per scored day
primaryComparison.primaryStatistic: M = the mean of Δ_d over PROSPECTIVE days: each day counts once, however many pairs it has
primaryComparison.minimumCoverage: At least 15 of the 25 pairs EVALUATED in the recorded scan; a day below it is excluded and counted
primaryComparison.youngListings: GRAM-USDT and HYPE-USDT reach 199 closed candles inside the period (about 2027-01-16 and 2027-04-10, if their series stay complete) and are ranked from then on as the scanner ranks them. The universe does not change
primaryComparison.onlyComparison: No other horizon, group, baseline, threshold or subset is analysed under this study

dependence.overlap: Consecutive days' 20-day windows share 19 days. Scored days are split into 21 phase series by (days since 2026-11-12) mod 21; windows within one series never share a bar. M is reported per series
dependence.correlation: Pairs move together on each day. Δ_d is one value per day, so pairs are never counted as independent trials
dependence.noSignificance: No p-value, confidence interval or significance claim. About 17 non-overlapping windows per series is a small sample, and the series overlap each other

missingData.substitution: none: no forward-fill, interpolation, reconstructed candle, other provider or Binance candle
missingData.pending: the reference or endpoint bar had not closed at the outcome retrieval’s cutoff
missingData.missing: no bar opening at the reference or endpoint day
missingData.invalid: the reference or endpoint bar fails OHLC validation, or appears twice
missingData.stoppedTrading: A pair whose bars stop (delisted or halted) inside its window has a MISSING outcome. It is counted and listed, never filled with its last price
missingData.topFiveIncomplete: A day whose top 5 has fewer than 3 AVAILABLE outcomes has no Δ_d; it is excluded and counted

classification.SUPPORTED: Collection minimum met, and all of: M > 0; the median of Δ_d > 0; M > 0 after removing the pair with the largest summed contribution to Δ_d, from the top 5 (not replaced by rank 6) and from the baseline, on every day; M > 0 in at least 11 of the 21 phase series; at most 2% of top-5 outcomes MISSING
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: Collection minimum met, M > 0, and at least one other SUPPORTED condition fails
classification.INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION: Collection minimum not met: the hypothesis is not classified
classification.meaning: SUPPORTED means only that the selected price-change association recurred on later data under this protocol. It is not a net trading return, not proof of profitability and not a reason to trade. NOT_SUPPORTED, INCONCLUSIVE and INSUFFICIENT_COLLECTION are reported with the same prominence

reporting: Collection: scored days in the period; PROSPECTIVE, RECONSTRUCTED and not-prospective (with reasons) counts; duplicates; days below coverage; PROSPECTIVE days per phase series and per calendar month

Primary: M; the median of Δ_d; the share of days with Δ_d > 0; M per phase series; M without the largest-contributing pair; the observation-level median difference; the share of top-5 outcomes MISSING
Breakdowns of the top 5 by pair and by calendar quarter, as in the retrospective study
Data revisions: how often each PROSPECTIVE scan's top 5 differs from a replay of the same day from the outcome retrieval
RECONSTRUCTED days: the same statistics in a separate, labeled table, never pooled
The classification, with the value of every condition
analysisCode: Written and tested on labeled fixtures, and committed, before 2027-12-04 and before the outcome retrieval. It implements this text and cannot change it; where they differ, this specification governs.
notDone: model tuning or any other horizon, group or threshold
scheduler, campaign, automation, orders, deployment or merge
net or portfolio returns, win rates, Sharpe or other risk-adjusted ratios, drawdown
the owner's personal trading trial, which stays deferred
